hypothesis: M199 shows the stage2 recipe from M197 seed 5197 is repeat-stable and both repeats improve fixed M193 objective while preserving behavior, protected key, old replay, and refreshed replay. A single short stage3 from the best fixed-loss retained repeat may continue the improvement without washing out the proof surface.
success_criteria: start from runs/ppo_m199_stage2_from_m197_seed5201/checkpoint.pt because it is the lowest fixed-loss retained repeat
run only one short guarded stage3 before any repeat or longer continuation
keep M194 as the strong action anchor through configs/ppo_m196_guarded_from_m194_smoke.json
preserve old M183 M168/M170 replay gates and refreshed M193 M189 replay gate
compare fixed M193 objective against M197, M198, and M199 before accepting any repeat
failure_criteria: run multiple stage3 seeds before the first stage3 gate passes
run a longer PPO continuation directly
drop any M183 or M193 replay row
promote based on fixed objective improvement alone
